observations.measure: Individuals referred for Robodebt APS Code of Conduct inquiries
observations.population: Referred current and former public servants and former agency heads
observations.denominator: 16 referred persons, not all APS staff
observations.note: Referral is not a finding of breach.

observations.measure: Individuals with final APS Code of Conduct breach determinations
observations.denominator: 16 referred persons; 12 had at least one breach determination
observations.note: APS employment-law findings, not criminal convictions; some other matters had no breach finding.

observations.measure: Total APS Code of Conduct breaches determined across 12 people
observations.note: Do not compare 97 occurrences with 16 people as a rate.

observations.measure: Current APS employees sanctioned after breach determinations
observations.population: Current APS employees found to have breached Code
observations.denominator: Exact current-employee eligible denominator not stated in cited summary
observations.note: Other respondents had left employment; do not infer 4/12 as a sanction rate or impunity.

observations.measure: Allegations against APS Commissioner examined in two independent investigations
observations.population: Two separate complaints about the Commissioner's handling of Robodebt inquiry
observations.denominator: 10 allegations: 7 in first investigation and 3 in second
observations.note: Distinct from 16 Robodebt referrals; allegations are not findings.

observations.measure: Allegations substantiated against APS Commissioner in two independent investigations
observations.population: Ten allegations about handling of Robodebt inquiry
observations.note: Investigators concluded no APS Code of Conduct breach by Commissioner; do not conflate with Robodebt substantive findings.

observations.measure: CRA overall contact-centre service-level result: calls answered within 15 minutes
observations.population: CRA contact-centre program calls for fiscal year
observations.denominator: Agency service-level definition in audit Exhibit 5; not unique callers
observations.note: Audit Exhibit 5, 2023–24 total row; compare only with same service-level measure.

observations.measure: CRA overall contact-centre service-level result: calls answered within 15 minutes
observations.population: CRA contact-centre program calls for fiscal year
observations.denominator: Agency service-level definition in audit Exhibit 5; not unique callers
observations.note: Audit Exhibit 5, 2024–25 total row; distinct from 65% service target.

observations.measure: CRA target share of calls answered within 15 minutes
observations.note: Do not treat this target as an achieved service observation.

observations.measure: Mean time to reach a CRA contact-centre agent for callers choosing an agent
observations.population: CRA calls where caller sought an agent
observations.denominator: Call wait time; excludes people unable to reach an agent
observations.note: Rounded mean in audit; not time to complete a tax/benefit claim.

observations.measure: Calls redirected to self-service without an option to speak to an agent
observations.denominator: Audit Exhibit 5: 8,630 thousand deflected calls; calls not unique people
observations.note: Not the count of abandoned calls or people denied benefits.

observations.measure: Accuracy of CRA answers to general individual-tax questions in auditor test calls
observations.denominator: 167 audit calls overall across categories; subgroup n not given in summary
observations.note: Not accuracy of all CRA advice or account-specific calls; audit also tested other categories.

observations.measure: CRA-reported caller satisfaction with call experience
observations.population: Respondents to CRA satisfaction surveys after answered calls
observations.denominator: Surveys covered less than 2% of answered calls; excluded callers not reaching an agent
observations.note: Not a representative all-caller satisfaction rate; selection limitation flagged by auditor.

observations.measure: Increase in complaints about CRA contact-centre agent service
observations.population: Complaints logged by CRA contact-centre service
observations.denominator: Relative change in complaints across years, not complaints per caller
observations.note: Do not infer individual dissatisfaction probability; call volumes also changed.

events.subject: Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme
events.disposition: Investigation commenced; establishment is not a final personal misconduct determination.

events.subject: Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme
events.finding: Royal Commission delivered final report to Governor-General.
events.disposition: Distinct from later APS individual Code of Conduct inquiries.

events.subject: Australian Government
events.finding: Government tabled response and accepted or accepted in principle all 56 Royal Commission recommendations.
events.disposition: Commitment to respond is not evidence of implementation.

events.subject: Australian Public Service Commission
events.finding: Fifteen matters had notices of potential breach; four preliminary breach determinations; one matter did not reach notice threshold.
events.disposition: Provisional findings must not be treated as final; later final report supersedes interim status.

events.subject: Australian Public Service Commission
events.finding: Final inquiries found 12 of 16 referred individuals breached APS Code on 97 occasions; four current employees sanctioned.
events.disposition: Employment Code findings, not criminal convictions; non-sanction of former employees not automatically impunity.

events.subject: Australian Public Service Commissioner
events.finding: Public statement reported independent investigations of 10 allegations against Commissioner found none substantiated.
events.disposition: Separate from substantive Robodebt inquiries; findings of no breach must be preserved.

events.subject: Office of the Auditor General of Canada
events.finding: Auditor published 2024–25 CRA contact-centre service findings including 18% timely responses against 65% target.
events.disposition: Audit measures administrative service, not individual misconduct or national political trust.

methodology.unitOfAnalysis: Agency service calls vs referred persons vs allegations vs breach occurrences are distinct.
methodology.statusGuardrail: Allegations, provisional decisions, final administrative determinations, sanctions, audit findings, and survey perceptions are never interchangeable.
methodology.denominatorGuardrail: Do not divide sanctions by all referred persons; do not treat calls as unique people; audit test call category denominator not reported.
methodology.timeGuardrail: 2024 final outcomes supersede February 2024 interim inquiry status; FY periods not survey waves.
methodology.modelGuardrail: No causal or cross-country trend model from these non-harmonized records.
methodology.productionGuardrail: Do not merge into redistricting data/app-feed.json or frontend without independent compatibility and licensing checks.
